title: Log-concave functions and transformations thereof
abstract: arXiv:2512.07768v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I summarize Bagnoli and Bergstrom (2005)'s review on log-concave functions, make several corrections, and augment the discussion with further results that can be useful in establishing monotone hazard rates. I also provide an application to monopoly pricing, where log-concavity of the demand curve implies strict concavity of the revenue function in quantity.

translated_abstract: 本文总结了Bagnoli和Bergstrom（2005）关于对数凹函数的综述，进行了若干修正，并通过进一步的结果扩展了相关讨论，这些结果在建立单调风险率时可能有用。我还提供了一个在垄断定价中的应用，其中需求曲线的对数凹性意味着收入函数在数量上是严格凹的。
tldr: 本文修正并扩展了Bagnoli和Bergstrom（2005）关于对数凹函数的综述，提供了有助于建立单调风险率的新结果，并将其应用于垄断定价，证明需求曲线的对数凹性意味着收入函数在数量上严格凹。
en_tdlr: This paper corrects and extends Bagnoli and Bergstrom's (2005) review of log-concave functions with additional results useful for establishing monotone hazard rates, and applies them to monopoly pricing, showing that log-concavity of the demand curve implies strict concavity of the revenue function in quantity.
